newsitem.title: USA: Republican wins Arkansas Senate seat.
newsitem.headline: Republican wins Arkansas Senate seat.

text.p: Republican Rep. Tim Hutchison defeated Democratic state Attorney General Winston Bryant for the open Senate seat in President Clinton's home state of Arkansas, television networks projected Tuesday.

The loss of the Arkansas seat formerly held by retiring Democratic Sen. David Pryor will make it more difficult for Democrats to win control of the Senate. Republicans held a 53-47 advantage with 34 Senate races this year and the Arkansas race was one of four in the South where Democrats had retired, giving Republicans a chance to gain power.
